tools.name: places_search
tools.description: Search Google Maps local businesses in real time by natural-language query (e.g. "HVAC contractors in Austin, TX") and return ratings, review counts, E.164 phone numbers, website domains, street addresses, opening hours, Place IDs, CIDs, and GPS coordinates. tools.name: places_nearby
tools.description: Discover Google Maps businesses inside a geographic viewport around exact GPS coordinates (lat, lng, zoom). Cost: 5 Credits / place returned (0 Credits if empty).

tools.name: places_details
tools.description: Retrieve the complete Google Business Profile by place_id, cid, or hex google_id including 1–5 star rating distribution, E.164 phone, website, categories, weekly work hours, and coordinates. Cost: 20 Credits / place (+20 if enrich_contacts=true and contacts found).

tools.name: places_reviews
tools.description: Extract verified customer reviews for any Google Maps business sorted by newest, most_relevant, highest_rating, or lowest_rating, including reviewer profile, star rating, text, owner reply, and review photos. Cost: 2 Credits / review returned ($0.08–$0.20/1K reviews; 0 Credits if empty).

tools.name: places_photos
tools.description: Retrieve high-resolution storefront, interior, and menu photo URLs and dimensions for any Google Maps place. Cost: 2 Credits / photo returned (0 Credits if empty).

tools.name: leads_enrich
tools.description: Crawl a local business website domain in real time to extract public B2B email addresses, phone numbers, and LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X/Twitter, YouTube, and TikTok profile URLs. Cost: 20 Credits when emails or social links are found (0 Credits if empty).

tools.name: places_autocomplete
tools.description: Real-time typeahead place and street address predictions with optional coordinate and country biasing. Cost: 5 Credits / call (0 Credits if empty).

tools.name: geocode_reverse
tools.description: Convert raw GPS latitude and longitude coordinates into structured street addresses, Plus Codes, neighborhoods, and Google Place IDs. Cost: 5 Credits / call.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: places_search, places_photos, leads_enrich · Private data: places_details · Public sink: leads_enrich.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: places_search, places_photos, leads_enrich · Private data: places_details · Public sink: leads_enrich

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
